narrative_paragraphs:
Agentic brand intelligence is the use of autonomous AI agents to continuously monitor, analyze, and manage a brand’s digital presence, reputation, and market positioning. Unlike static dashboards or reactive generative AI, these agents set goals, adapt to changing market narratives, and execute corrective actions without constant human oversight

. PRWeek +4

Historically, building brand loyalty and tracking perception required manual campaign reviews and tedious data parsing. Agentic intelligence shifts this paradigm by operating across several key areas: Adobe for Business +1
